metadata.title: The kitchen and recipe of Bru tribe in North Tripura | त्रिपुरा में ब्रू जनाजति की रसोई और रेसिपी
metadata.description: Bru tribe has it's own distinct identity and culture. Bru or Reang is a community indigenous to Northeast India, living mostly in Tripura, Mizoram and Assam. In Tripura, they are recognised as a Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group. Today we will take you to a Bru settlement in North Tripura and show you their beautiful kitchen and a very simple yet unique recipe.
